rules.name: Ancient Enemies
rules.description: All units within a Host of Talsyn army gain the Hatred (Beastman Brayherds) special rule.

rules.name: Protectors of the Ancient Wood
rules.description: Whilst it controls a special feature, a unit within a Host of Talsyn army may re-roll any rolls To Hit and To Wound of a natural 1 during the Combat phase.
